name: 86 Chaos 16.0.89 Admin Push Release Gate Fix
label: 86 Chaos 16.0.89 Admin Push Release Gate Fix
releaseTitle: 86 Chaos 16.0.89 Admin Push Release Gate Fix
notes: System Administrator runtime errors are no longer mislabeled as stale lazy-chunk failures merely because the stack contains /static/js/.
Push repair dismissal is keyed to a stable repair request nonce or legacy fallback instead of changing failure/status fields.
The secured push self-repair API verifies the caller profile after update before returning success.
The release-gate dependency-install step now has live observable output, heartbeat, timeout handling, overlap protection, and blocked-before-test reporting.
